name: Direct-Value Quantizer
description: Error-bounded direct-value quantizer with lossless outlier fallback. Quantizes input values directly (not prediction residuals). ABS/NOA: uniform quantization step = 2·eb; values beyond the quant radius are stored losslessly as (value, index) pairs. REL: log2-space encoding (|error|/|x| <= eb, exact per-element PFPL bound). Linear mode (setLinearMode) emits raw signed codes with no outlier path, intended for the cuSZp pipeline (→ LorenzoStage(blockSize) → AdaptiveBitpackStage). Three forward outputs: codes, outlier_vals, outlier_idxs (one output in linear/inplace mode). Provenance: ABS/NOA/REL scheme and outlier handling follow the LC/PFPL framework; independently written kernels.

config.name: errorBound
config.description: Error bound value. Interpretation set by errorMode.

config.name: errorMode
config.description: ABS = absolute |x-x'|<=eb; NOA = value-range relative eb*(max-min); REL = true per-element PFPL relative |x-x'|/|x|<=eb via log2-space encoding (requires u32 TCode for wide data ranges).

config.name: quantRadius
config.description: Quantization radius. Values at bin index >= radius are stored as outliers. Default 2^15 for u16 TCode.

config.name: outlierCapacity
config.description: Fraction of input size reserved for outlier storage.

config.name: zigzagCodes
config.description: ABS/NOA only: zigzag-encode the quantization codes before storage to improve compressibility when codes cluster near zero. No effect in REL mode.

config.name: linearMode
config.description: ABS/NOA: linear/no-outlier mode (cuSZp-style). Emits raw signed codes q=round(x/2·eb), no radius clamp, no outlier ports. Pair with LorenzoStage(setBlockSize) → AdaptiveBitpackStage.
